- Julia Kiersch (Talent Acquisition), julia.kiersch@basf.com, Tel: +49 30 2005-59139 will be happy to answer your questions for this position.

WELCOME

If you're someone who inspires others, owns their impact and wants to elevate what they do, you'll fit right in.

Until July 1, our business was part of BASF. As part of the current transition, all job listings and the application process are still hosted on the BASF platform and therefore fully presented in BASF branding.
Please do not be confused by this: All roles are positions at Surventis, and your application will be submitted to us.

At Surventis, we go beyond the surface - in everything we do. We put customers at the center, think one step ahead, and develop solutions that create real value and lasting partnerships.
We inspire each other to think further, take ownership of our work, and constantly push to elevate what's possible. If you bring your full self, challenge the obvious answer, and want to grow with a team that means it - this is your place.

WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT
Within our unit Global EHS (EHS/G), we develop globally applicable, fundamental Environment, Health and Safety (EHS) principles and concepts for Surventis in close cooperation with Operations and other expert functions. In addition, we support the implementation of these concepts and verify compliance with legal requirements and EHS standards through audits.

- In your new role, you develop global physical security standards (so w/o cyber security) for our organization and sites and take responsibility for their continuous development.
- You collaborate closely with local, regional, and global experts across the company and coordinate security-related topics with relevant stakeholders.
- In addition, you support our units in implementing and applying global physical security standards.
- You also take responsibility for implementing relevant security tools to support physical security.
- Based on relevant information, you conduct security analyses and prepare meaningful reports.
- Last but not least, you manage security incident reporting as well as the analysis and evaluation of security incidents.

WHAT YOU OFFER

- master's degree in security management, risk-/crisis management or a comparable field
- several years of operational and project experience
- sound knowledge of physical security standards (legal and chemical industry)
- creative and motivated team player with a growth mindset and positive attitude
- fluent English skills and experience working with international teams; command of another language is an advant´ö-..ge

WHAT WE OFFER

- We offer an attractive salary with individual benefits such as performance-related bonuses. Company-funded supplementary health insurance, accident insurance and pension related benefits
- We offer a wide range of local and global development and career opportunities for professional and personal development
- Surventis stands for diversity - we are proud of our Coatings employee networks WomenInCoatings, Color Pride and CultiConnect
- The feedback culture is firmly integrated into our corporate culture, e.g. through regular employee surveys and management feedback
- At our location in Münster, we have our own fitness studio "Freizeit" with a physiotherapy practice, permanently employed company doctors, a company restaurant "Auszeit" including a café bar, a bilingual company daycare center "LackiKids" and a vacation program "LackiKids on Tour".

Are you passionate about driving energy and sustainability initiatives in an international environment? Your responsibilities

- Take global responsibility for Energy Management across all seven international sites (six in Europe, one in the US) •  Conduct energy reviews, energy audits and general QHSE audits

This is an international role with high impact and ownership, with the opportunity to actively contribute to energy efficiency improvements worldwide. Does this sound like the right challenge for you? If so, we look forward to receiving your application in English via e-mail to: bewerbungen@genan.com

Your tasks Welcome to PAION Pharma!

We are a pharmaceutical company specialising in the research, development, manufacturing and distribution of medicines. Our focus is on intensive care medicine, anaesthesiology and infectious diseases.
To strengthen our growing team in Aachen, we are looking for an experienced and motivated Supply Chain Manager (m/f/d) .
Your Role:

In this position, you will ensure smooth and efficient supply chain operations and act as a key interface between suppliers, contract manufacturers, customers, logistics service providers and internal stakeholders. You will contribute to customer satisfaction, process optimisation and operational excellence while ensuring compliance with relevant GxP and GDP requirements.
Your Responsibilities:
• Prepare quotations and monitor purchase and sales orders
• Coordinate inbound and outbound shipments, including GDP documentation
• Work closely with contract manufacturers, B2B customers and logistics service providers
• Monitor inventory and support supply chain planning activities
• Review invoices and ensure accurate ERP postings
• Analyse supply chain, shipping and delivery data to identify optimisation opportunities
• Prepare supply chain performance reports
• Ensure accurate and compliant documentation in accordance with GxP guidelines
• Support day-to-day supply chain operations and related activities

Your profile
• Degree in Business Administration or a comparable field, or equivalent professional training with extensive relevant experience
• At least 5 years of professional experience in customer service, procurement and/or logistics within a relevant industry
• Proven experience with ERP systems
• Ideally, you also bring: experience in managing and collaboratioing with contract manufacturers and external logistics providers, and experince in project management

Your Skills
• Advanced written and verbal communication skills in English and German
• Strong service orientation and customer focus
• High level of reliability, resilience and attention to detail
• Strong organisational, analytical and problem-solving skills
• Proactive and solution-oriented mindset
• Ability to work independently and effectively as part of a team

Why us?
• 30 days vacation (full time) and additional benefits
• Short communication channels, open doors and helpful, committed colleagues
• Flexible working hours with partial home office (max. 2 days/week)
• Modern office building with underground parking spaces in a location close to the A44 motorway

If you are a motivated supply chain professional looking for a dynamic and quality-driven environment, we look forward to hearing from you.

Job Description

As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.

The Clinical Diagnostics Division (CDD) provides innovative diagnostic solutions across selected in vitro diagnostics (IVD) market segments and has been a trusted partner to the IVD industry for more than 40 years.

Our portfolio includes solutions for drugs-of-abuse testing, therapeutic drug monitoring, quality control, sepsis diagnosis, prenatal screening and more. In addition, CDD offers advanced laboratory instrumentation and high-throughput automation solutions for a wide range of clinical laboratory environments.

Our products and solutions are delivered through direct sales, regional distributors and OEM partnerships.

Territory: Eastern & Central Germany
ZIP Codes: 01, 02, 04, 06, 07, 08, 09, 30, 31, 32, 34, 36, 37, 38, 99
Field-based / Remote within the territory

Discover Impactful Work

We are looking for an experienced Account Manager (m/f/d) – Clinical Diagnostics to drive commercial growth across Eastern and Central Germany.

In this field-based role, you will take ownership of a strategically important sales territory, developing existing customer relationships while identifying and winning new business opportunities.

As a trusted advisor to clinical laboratories and healthcare customers, you will combine your scientific understanding with a consultative sales approach to identify customer needs, understand laboratory workflows and develop solutions that deliver measurable value.

You will work closely with customers, key decision-makers and internal cross-functional teams to expand our market presence, increase revenue and strengthen long-term partnerships.

A Day in the Life

- Develop and execute strategic territory and account plans to achieve or exceed annual sales targets
- Take full ownership of revenue growth, pipeline development and commercial performance within the assigned territory
- Manage, develop and grow relationships with existing key accounts
- Identify, qualify and convert new business opportunities within clinical laboratories and other relevant customer segments
- Build strong relationships with laboratory managers, clinicians, procurement teams, technical specialists and other key decision-makers
- Apply a consultative selling approach to understand customer applications, workflows, challenges and future requirements
- Position Thermo Fisher Scientific’s clinical diagnostic solutions effectively and develop compelling value propositions
- Manage the complete sales cycle, from opportunity identification and customer engagement through negotiation and closing
- Collaborate closely with Applications, Technical Service, Marketing, Customer Service and other commercial teams to deliver an outstanding customer experience
- Maintain an accurate and high-quality sales pipeline, forecast and customer data within Salesforce
- Monitor market trends, competitor activities and customer developments to identify new growth opportunities
- Represent Thermo Fisher Scientific at customer meetings, industry events, conferences and exhibitions
- Ensure high levels of customer satisfaction and develop sustainable, long-term business partnerships

Keys to Success

You combine a strong scientific or technical background with commercial drive and a genuine passion for understanding and solving customer challenges.

You are comfortable managing a large territory independently, identifying growth opportunities and engaging with stakeholders at different levels of an organization. At the same time, you enjoy working collaboratively within a global, cross-functional organization.

Education & Experience

- Master’s degree in Life Sciences, Biology, Chemistry, Biochemistry, Biotechnology, Medical Technology or another relevant scientific discipline
- Minimum 5 years of successful sales experience, preferably within clinical diagnostics, IVD, laboratory solutions, life sciences, medical technology or healthcare
- Proven track record of achieving or exceeding sales targets and developing a sales territory
- Experience managing complex customer relationships and sales cycles
- Experience working with clinical laboratories, hospitals or other diagnostic customers is highly desirable

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

- Strong technical and scientific understanding, with the ability to quickly understand customer applications and laboratory workflows
- Excellent consultative selling, communication, presentation and negotiation skills
- Strong commercial mindset with the ability to identify and develop new business opportunities
- Demonstrated ability to build trusted, long-term relationships with customers and key decision-makers
- Strong analytical, strategic planning and territory management capabilities
- Results-oriented, proactive and accountable approach to sales
- Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within a cross-functional and matrix organization
- Proficiency with CRM systems, preferably Salesforce, and Microsoft Office applications
- Valid driver’s license
- Willingness to travel approximately 50–75% within the assigned territory

Language Requirements

- Fluent German is essential (C1 level or above)
- Strong professional English skills are required for communication within our international organization

Benefits:
We offer competitive remuneration, annual incentive plan bonus, healthcare, and a range of employee benefits. Thermo Fisher Scientific offers employment with an innovative, forward-thinking organization, and outstanding career and development prospects. We offer an exciting company culture that stands for integrity, intensity, involvement, and innovation!

Our Mission is to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. Watch (https://jobs.thermofisher.com/global/en/5-reasons-to-work-at-thermo-fisher-scientific)  as our colleagues explain 5 reasons to work with us. As one team of 100,000+ colleagues, we share a common set of values - Integrity, Intensity, Innovation and Involvement - working together to accelerate research, solve complex scientific challenges, drive technological innovation and support patients in need. #StartYourStory at Thermo Fisher Scientific (https://corporate.thermofisher.com/us/en/index.html) , where diverse experiences, backgrounds and perspectives are valued.

Apply today! http://jobs.thermofisher.com

Soldering operator

Working as as soldering operator at Benchmark means making solder joints, both mechanically as manually.

As a solder operator at Benchmark you are responsible for manually placing components on prints. When necessary you check, and touch-up, prints. Your experience and skills help you on a daily basis to make additional or changed connections.

Your tasks are, amongst others:

· Visually checking the PCB with the help of digital instructions and technical drawings

· Determining the process, together with manufacturing engineers, for (process) parameters for the series

· Identifying deviations from the predetermined standards

· Soldering, touch-op and outcoming goods inspection

You will work with different kind of toolings, such as: soldering iron, hot plates and/or dryers. It is a very precise job where you will be working via a microscope or dynascope.

What Benchmark has to offer to you:

· A salary between € 2,751 - € 3,292 gross per month based on 40 hour workweek, depending on your knowledge and experience.

· Broad development opportunities with the help of our Benchmark Academy.

· Entrepreneurship is seen, valued and encouraged.

· BeFit program: stay fit by exercising weekly with your colleagues or participating in sporting events.

· A turnover-related quarterly bonus that can amount to 5%. This percentage may vary.

· 40 vacation days during the year, when you are working on a full-time basis.

What do we ask of you?

· Experience as a soldering operator or experience with a micro-soldering.

· Being able to work very precise and accurate.

· Being able to read and follow technical drawings/work instructions.

· Good knowledge of either the Dutch or English language.

About Benchmark:

Benchmark in Almelo is part of the multinational Benchmark Electronics Inc., a listed company in the field of manufacturing electronics and providing services to original equipment manufacturers (OEMs).

At Benchmark you work for companies that make an impact with their innovations. We develop new products that improve safety or health or increase convenience. These products are supplied from product design to volume production and sometimes directly to the end user. This entire process, from design to production, is carried out entirely in Almelo.

Globally, Benchmark Electronics Inc. currently has 23 locations. In Almelo, the Netherlands, you will be working with up to 750 colleagues.

jobs.occupation: Research Associate / PhD Studend / PostDoc (m/f/x) Adaptive multiplane light conversion (Physiker/in)
jobs.description:
TUD Dresden University of Technology, as a University of Excellence, is one of the leading and most dynamic research institutions in the country. Accordingly, we welcome all applicants who would like to commit themselves, their achievements and productivity to the success of the whole institution.

At the Faculty of Electrical and Computer Engineering, Institute of Circuits and Systems, the Chair of Measurement and Sensor System Technique offers a position as

Research Associate / PhD Studend / PostDoc (m/f/x)

Adaptive multiplane light conversion

(subject to personal qualification, employees are remunerated according to salary group E 13 TV-L)

within the Reinhart-Koselleck-project starting as soon as possible. The position is limited to 3 years. The period of employment is governed by the Fixed Term Research Contracts Act (Wissenschaftszeitvertragsgesetz - WissZeitVG). The position comprises up to 100% of the fulltime weekly hours. Balancing family and career are an important issue. The position is generally suitable for candidates seeking part-time employment. Please indicate your request in your application. The position offers the chance to obtain further academic qualification (usually PhD / habilitation thesis).

Tasks:

The focus is on research into innovative concepts for closed-loop control with multiplane light conversion using spatial light modulators, which enable multiplexing via the spatial degrees of freedom towards aberration correction in multimode fibers. For this purpose, spatial modulation techniques for the generation of structured light are investigated for classical laser waves and entangled photons. Your activities include the realization of an adaptive multiplane light conversion system, the implementation of experiments toward the transfer of the unique advantages to real-world applications and the scientific publication of the results. Your responsibilities include:

- characterization of the transmission properties of multimode optical fibers using physics-informed deep learning
- experimental and simulation-based investigations of optical diffractive neural networks
- development and implementation of novel diffractive networks for mode, wavelength, and polarization multiplexing in multimode optical fibers
- publication of research results in international scientific journals, filing of patents, and presentation of conference contributions (the research group has delivered more than 100 invited talks on all continents in recent years)
- the position can be flexibly tailored to focus on experimental laboratory work or simulation-based studies

Requirements: 

- above-average university degree in in the subject physics, computer science, information systems technique, electrical engineering, mechatronics, or related areas
- ability and willingness to work independently and conceptually in a team, in a goal-oriented manner, with a high level of commitment 
- excellent written and spoken German and English skills
- interest in practice-oriented, interdisciplinary collaboration with international cooperation partners from research and industry
- knowledge of software development, deep learning, computational imaging, Fourier optics
- previous knowledge of quantum optics, waveguide optics, multiplane light conversion, MATLAB or Python is advantageous

We offer: 

- a diverse, cutting-edge and challenging research position with your own externally funded research project, dedicated funding and opportunities to shape and develop your research 
- an interdisciplinary research group whose pioneering paradigm shifts have been recognized with prestigious awards (more than 100 awards in total) 
- state-of-the-art laboratories and research facilities 
- opportunities to publish in high-quality scientific journals and attend international conferences for scientific exchange 
- excellent connections with research and industry partners 
- flexible working hours 
- 30 days of annual leave (based on a five-day working week) 
- participation in the supplementary public-sector pension scheme through VBL

TUD strives to employ more women in academia and research. We therefore expressly encourage women to apply. The university is a family-friendly university. We welcome applications from candidates with disabilities. If multiple candidates prove to be equally qualified, those with disabilities or with equivalent status pursuant to the German Social Code IX (SGB IX) will receive priority for employment.

Application:

Please submit your detailed application with the usual documents by September 23, 2026 (stamped arrival date of the university central mail service or the time stamp on the email server of TUD applies), by sending it as a single pdf file to grp-application-mst@msx.tu-dresden.de (https://mailto:grp-application-mst@msx.tu-dresden.de)  (Please note: We are currently not able to receive electronically signed and encrypted data) or to:

TU Dresden, Chair of Measurement and Sensor System Technique, Prof. Juergen Czarske, Helmholtzstr. 10, 01069 Dresden, Germany.

Please submit copies only, as your application will not be returned to you. Expenses incurred in attending interviews cannot be reimbursed.

TUD is a founding partner in the DRESDEN-concept alliance.

Reference to data protection: Your data protection rights, the purpose for which your data will be processed, as well as further information about data protection is available to you on the website:
https://tu-dresden.de/karriere/datenschutzhinweis (https://tu-dresden.de/karriere/datenschutzhinweis) .

jobs.description:
The Hotel Dampfmühle offers 85 rooms with an attractive variety of categories: from modern deluxe rooms, comfortable studios to luxurious wellness suites. Various event areas, as well as the Jules breakfast restaurant with a generous terrace, as well as the small fitness area with sauna and rooftop terrace and wellness sublet offerings complete the range of services. Ideally located between the Ruhr area and the Lower Rhine, we combine hotel operations, events and personal hospitality in a special location with a lot of potential. With us, you will find a secure job in a medium-sized company, a planable monthly service schedule, holiday and Christmas pay, and fair working conditions without unpaid overtime. We would like to strengthen our team and are ideally looking for one or two people who are willing to actively help design our house. We are open to different profiles: from young talent after training to experienced hotel professionals to motivated people who have not previously had the opportunity to take on more responsibility.

Hotel Manager / Allrounder Hotel & Guest Service (m/w/d) Reception

Breakfast Full-time I part-time possible

- Check-in and check-out
- Acceptance and processing of reservations and requests Telephone and written guest Correspondence Accounting,

- Want to get a foothold in the hotelier industry as a junior or junior already have experience, but have so far been given too little responsibility, want a new challenge in a family-friendly hotel environment

- A varied workplace right on the Rhine
- A planned monthly service plan
- No unpaid overtime
- Holiday allowance
- Christmas money
- Opportunity for the JobBike

- Free parking Employee discounts
- Discounts on company products and services

We want flexibility, but we are also willing to work together to find a solution that suits your life situation and our operation. The arbovirus research group of PD Dr. Beate Kümmerer at the Institute of Virology at the University Hospital Bonn (Germany) is looking for a highly motivated

PhD student (m/f/d)

to join our team and explore the fascinating biology of orthoflavivirus-host interaction in mosquitoes and vertebrates. The PhD position (65% E13 salary according to DFG recommendations), initially limited to three years, is advertisedwithin the framework of the DFG-funded CRC/Transregio 237 “Nucleic Acid Immunity” and is to be filled by January 2027.

The position is offered on a fixed-term basis until December 31, 2029.
Mosquito-borne RNA viruses, such as dengue, yellow fever, and Zika virus, cause severe disease outbreaks worldwide. As climate change drives the spread of mosquito vectors, the regions affected by these viruses continue to expand. Orthoflaviviruses have evolved multiple strategies to evade innate immune recognition, thereby promoting viral replication and pathogenesis. The project aims to elucidate how viral RNA structures and RNA modifications shape innate immune recognition. A particular focus will be the identification of mosquito proteins that recognize viral cap0 RNA and the characterization of viral immune antagonists in both mosquito and vertebrate hosts. We hope to gain mechanistic insights into virus-host interactions that support the development of innovative antiviral therapies and sustainable vector control strategies.

Methods: Molecular biology methods, cell culture and virological methods, RNA-protein and protein-protein interaction studies, gene expression analyses, cellular knock-down, as well as research involving mosquitoes.

Johannes Gutenberg University Mainz (JGU) is one of the largest universities in Germany. Thanks to its location in the Rhine-Main science region, the university can unfold to its full potential and showcase its innovative power and dynamism. Its status as a comprehensive university allows for multidisciplinary learning and teaching and has great potential for internationally renowned, interdisciplinary research. Almost all of its institutes are located on a single campus close to the Mainz city center - creating a lively academic culture for researchers, teaching staff, and students from every continent.
PhD student: Plant RNA Biology
The Wachter group at the Institute for Molecular Physiology (Faculty 10: Biology of Johannes Gutenberg University Mainz) investigates the molecular mechanisms and biological functions of alternative RNA splicing in plants. Our recent work identified a structured mRNA element that regulates specific DEAD-box helicase genes and revealed their critical role in controlling alternative splicing. Intriguingly, these functions appear to be linked to unique C-terminal features of the respective helicases. As a member of an interdisciplinary and international research team, you will investigate the molecular mechanisms underlying the splicing-regulatory activity of these DEAD-box helicases, with a particular focus on the functional relevance of RGG motifs, subcellular localisation, and their potential involvement in phase separation. In collaboration with the Weinberg group (University Halle-Wittenberg), you will also explore how helicase targeting of pre-mRNA structural elements may intersect with the binding of splicing regulators to determine splice site choice. Your research will employ a multidisciplinary approach that integrates molecular biology, RNA biochemistry, cell biology, and plant physiology, with Arabidopsis thaliana as the primary model system. You will benefit from extensive expertise, various core facilities, and a completely new research infrastructure. The PhD project is funded by the DFG and can be integrated in the international PhD programme (IPP) in Mainz.
Applying state-of-the-art techniques for gene-specific and genome-wide analyses of RNA biology, including transcriptome-wide profiling of alternative splicing and mapping of protein-RNA interactions

Thinking of doing your PhD in the Life Sciences? The International PhD Programme (IPP) Mainz is offering talented scientists the chance to work on cutting edge research projects. As an IPP PhD student, you will join a community of exceptional scientists working on diverse topics ranging from how organisms age or how our DNA is repaired, to how epigenetics regulates cellular identity or neural memory. The research group of Johannes Mayer offers the following PhD project:
Circulating myeloid cells, which include monocytes, dendritic cells and granulocytes, are short lived and continuously replenished by the bone marrow. Under non-inflammatory conditions, myelopoiesis follows relatively ordered differentiation routes that sustain circulating monocytes and granulocytes and seed tissue macrophage and dendritic cell compartments. Both mature cells and bone marrow progenitors have the capacity to rapidly reconfigure during local and systemic inflammation, with cell-cell communication cues from stromal, endothelial, and lymphoid niches helping to calibrate output and function.

Myeloid cell activation and exhaustion has both been described on a mature cell and progenitor cell level, leading to emergency myelopoiesis or hematopoietic halt/shock. Using single-cell and multi-omic profiling integrated with trajectory inference and ligand-receptor/network modeling, this project will establish a perturbation landscape of different myeloid cells and their progenitors in the context of different inflammatory cues using in silico modelling and in vitro validation.

PhD project: Defining Myeloid cell Ageing and its immunological impact on a single cell level

In our lab, we have established an integrated toolkit to study myeloid cell biology at single-cell resolution. Combined with datamining, LLM studies, in vitro activation and CRISPR/Cas9 perturbation screen, you will study the activation and exhaustion landscape of different myeloid cell types and their progenitors. In addition, you will work together with the team to characterize inflammatory models in vivo that span both systemic and local inflammation and track myeloid cell and progenitor activation and exhaustion over time.

This PhD requires a strong background in immunology, previous experience with both wet lab and dry lab work on a single-cell level and a willingness to work with in vivo animal models, including handling, experimental design and tissue processing and analysis.

If you are interested in this project, please select Mayer (Activate) as your project preference in the IPP application platform.
